arrival_pattern: closed-loop synchronized burst; each learner two sequential turns

questions: After how many ticks does Glimmer lease expire?
After how many steps does Lumen protocol reject a token?

decision: Keep bounded loopback development only; broader deployment and teaching quality unqualified
limitations: Two short factual question templates repeated within six dependent local bursts; not 180 independent pedagogical cases.
Setup uses real API and ingestion worker plus synthetic identity/policy fixture; no browser, private source, public TLS, Docker/cloud or uptime claim.
Historical selected-profile binding is staging setup only; explicit v3 candidate not release promotion.
Non-answer actions and missing citations fail operational gate, but answer presence is not semantic grading.
Admission wait includes budget and ledger overhead, not pure queue time.
Not a controlled comparison with prior in-process v2 workload; host co-resident process snapshot retained locally.
No steady open-loop arrival-rate, overload beyond25 clients, many-turn long-context, streaming or recovery-under-load measurement.
